text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. With all her goal 
races for the year completed, things had 
settled down a bit... I told Duramente to 
get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She must be doing some extra training. 
Thinking that, I made my way to the track 
at night...
choice_data_list: There you are, just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just wrapping things up. I kept it 
on the lighter side, too.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, because I have faith in you.
It's okay, I believe in you

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...I see. Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Then, did you come to check on me?
choice_data_list: No, I came to invite you.
No, I came to invite you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: An invitation...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was sure Duramente would be working hard 
at training even on Christmas. Thinking 
that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to give them a breather and let 
them enjoy the holiday spirit, I put 
together a simple Christmas party.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The decorations, the food, the drinks... 
Did you do all of this?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...For my sake...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is it alright if I go change?
choice_data_list: You're fine just the way you are.
You're fine just the way you are.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No. I wouldn't want to attend your party 
in a dirty track jacket.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Since you went out of your way to set 
this up, just wait a little bit for me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, sorry to keep you waiting.
choice_data_list: I haven't been waiting long at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, Duramente came back in what felt 
like five seconds flat. ...She might have 
actually run somewhat seriously somewhere 
along the way.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Great. Now we can have the party.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
By the way, today's decorations... they're 
so lively, I like it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Did you pick all of these out yourself?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Hanging decorations from the lights too, 
huh? I see. It looks like the sky. How 
pretty."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: And this is...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The tree is gorgeous too. ...Ah, there's a 
snowman hiding in there.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I looked out the window earlier and was 
amazed. A snow-covered town... It's so 
lovely.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's cute.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes sparkling at the decorations, she 
wanders around the Trainer's Office... 
sharing her thoughts on every single one.
choice_data_list: I thought it was cute, like a child.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that... That wasn't a compliment, 
was it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I believe you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. What else did you prepare for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, this salad... is delicious. And its 
nutritional balance is flawless. Next 
is...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent a wonderful Christmas 
together with Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
One is supposed to dress up for a party, 
is one not?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I talked it over with Crown... and picked 
out an outfit with Christmas colors.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I know I might be a little out of place 
here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, today's party embodies your 
feelings. I want to... receive them with 
all my heart."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. For wanting to do something for 
my sake.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy. Your feelings are always... 
so comforting.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Let me say it too. Merry Christmas!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: And so... I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—Would you do me the honor of dancing 
with me after this?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You gave me a party as a present. I want 
to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I want to give back... the 
very same special feelings that I carry 
within me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Dancing is something special. It was what 
sparked the contract between you and me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, she was looking for an escort 
for the dance party celebrating her debut 
into her blooming period... and she just 
happened to ask me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Do you still remember... how I escorted 
you back then?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance, Trainer. I will gift you a 
wonderful feeling.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Ah, just like that... Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the quiet school at night with nobody 
around... I practiced my dancing while 
Duramente checked my moves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dancing face-to-face with her while a 
piano arrangement of a Christmas song 
plays... It was truly an extraordinary 
experience—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Could it be that you're 
nervous?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I could just kind of... feel it 
through your hand.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Your opponent is me. There are no 
spectators either."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You can relax.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list:
You seem a little different than usual 
too.

You seem a little different than usual, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, that was slightly amusing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Because usually... you're the mature 
one."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's strange. When your perspective 
changes... even people look different.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't mean to look down on you at 
all. If I offended you, I'm sorry. But—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Right now, you're... cute."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright. This time, I shall escort 
you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Things might get a little rough, but stay 
with me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, you're right. I promise."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looks straight at me, with sheer, 
unwavering earnestness. It's the dazzling 
gaze she wears before a race—utterly and 
completely beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trust me and follow my lead. If you do...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I will take you to the view from the 
absolute peak. —Come, take my hand.
